QuestInfo.name: Seizing the Ores
QuestInfo.0: #b#p3001000##k is bent out of shape because of the cookie incident, and is trying to gather information. Talk to #b#p3001000##k carefully so you don't upset him.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p3001000##k asks you to eliminate #b100#k #r#o2400108##k monsters at #b#m401030300##k and obtain #b30 #t4000729##k items.\n
QuestInfo.2: Just as you completed the mission for #b#p3001000##k, an urgent message arrived. What's going on?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:

0.0: I have gone over all of the information, and it looks like we may have to commit to a major offensive sooner rather than later. We must prepare well for the coming battles...\r\n
0.1: Therefore, I need you help us prepare by gathering materials. And fear not...you'll have plenty of chances to beat upon things as you do.
0.2: Specters are using their laborers to mine ore from the mountains. This has cut off an important resource of ours.
0.3: Ores are a must if we are to craft and repair our weapons and armor. Your next mission is collecting #b#t4000729##k items from #r#o2400108##k monsters. You'll do this for us, won't you?\r\n#r#e(If you accept, you will automatically move to the relevant field.)\r\n

yes.0: Great. Please eliminate #b100#k #r#o2400108##k monsters to hinder their mining process and obtain #b30 #t4000729##k items. You can find #r#o2400108##k monsters over at #b#m401030300##k.

no.0: We aren't in a situation where we can postpone much longer.

1.0: I hope you've brought us a hefty load of materials.

yes.0: This should be a simple matter for you, Kaiser. This close to the final battle, every little bit helps.
yes.1: Just a moment. I've received an urgent message...

item.0: We need far more #b#t4000729##k items, as you know. I need at least #30# to expand our equipment reserve. #r#o2400108##k monsters are over at #b#m401030300##k.

mob.0: Eliminate more of the #r#o2400108##k monsters. You have to defeat at least #b100#k of them to disrupt their ore operations. #r#o2400108##k monsters are over at #b#m401030300##k.
